Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0061, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0062 1. Lemma 2.34\group neckpinch

If $\psi _{ss}(x,0)\le 0$ on the polar cap, then $\psi _{ss}(x,t)\le 0$ on the polar cap for all later times.
